tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend PUT /summaries/{id}
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update a summary's body in place, optionally relabeling generated_by (agent -> user).

**Files:**
- Modify: backend/folio_backend/models.py (add SummaryUpdate), store.py (add update_summary), app.py (add PUT /summaries/{summary_id})
- Create: backend/tests/test_api_summary_update.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- PUT /summaries/{id} with {body} updates the row body in place (same id; GET reflects it); returns {id}
- PUT with {body, generated_by:'user'} relabels an agent summary to user
- existing suite still passes

**Verify:** nix-shell -p 'python3.withPackages(ps: with ps; [ fastapi uvicorn pydantic httpx werkzeug python-multipart starlette ebooklib beautifulsoup4 ])' --run 'python -m unittest tests.test_api_summary_update -v && python -m unittest discover -s tests' -> OK

**Steps:** TDD — write tests/test_api_summary_update.py (TestClient(create_app(temp_db)), POST then PUT, assert in-place update + relabel); confirm fail; add SummaryUpdate model, store.update_summary (UPDATE body, and generated_by when provided), PUT endpoint mirroring PUT /notes; confirm pass + full suite; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Frontend editable summaries UI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rework SummaryEditor to edit summaries in place (Markdown + Edit -> textarea), make agent summaries editable (relabel to user on save), and add new summaries via a create control.

**Files:**
- Modify: frontend/src/api/client.ts (add updateSummary), src/notesview/NotesView.tsx (rework SummaryEditor + wiring), src/notesview/NotesView.test.tsx (update summary tests), src/notesview/NotesView.module.css (as needed)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- editing an existing summary calls api.updateSummary(id, body) (not delete+create), preserves id
- editing an agent summary calls api.updateSummary(id, body, 'user')
- the Add control calls api.createSummary(scope, scopeId, body)
- all NotesView tests pass; full frontend suite passes

**Verify:** from frontend/: node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/notesview/NotesView.test.tsx then node_modules/.bin/vitest run -> all pass

**Steps:** TDD — update NotesView.test.tsx (add updateSummary to api mock; remove the delete+recreate and prefill tests; add add/edit-in-place/agent-relabel tests); confirm fail; add client.updateSummary (mirror updateNote, PUT with {body, generated_by}); replace NotesView saveSummary with createSummaryFor + updateSummaryBody handlers and pass onCreate/onUpdate to SummaryEditor; rewrite SummaryEditor to Markdown+Edit-button per-item model with an Add textarea (aria-labelledby heading so getByLabelText(label) targets it); confirm tests + full suite; commit.
